sn13.6:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāpaṭhavī parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya ṭhapetvā satta kolaṭṭhi mattiyo guḷikā.
sn13.6:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yaṃ vā mahāpaṭhaviyā parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ yā vā satta kolaṭṭhi mattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhāti.
sn13.6:2.1: etadeva bhante bahutaraṃ mahāpaṭhaviyā yadidaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ
sn13.6:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti mahāpaṭhaviyā parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ upanidhāya satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhāti.
